meta.title: Addiction Society — Addiction Data Observatory
meta.description: A data observatory that reads alcohol, drug, gambling and digital addiction as structural signals of society. Monitoring releases from 23 domestic and international sources, building indicators, policy and research archives.

calendarPage.missedDesc: The expected month has ended but the release has not been confirmed yet. Expectations are monthly, so a release only becomes past once its month is over. The tag says whether the monitor read the source after that month — "No release" means it read the page and saw nothing new, "Could not read" means reading the page failed.

ministry.desc: Each type of addiction — alcohol, gambling, internet, gaming, drugs — falls under a different ministry and a different implementing agency.
ministry.quote: "Each ministry operates under different laws, which makes it hard to build a cooperative framework."
ministry.quoteBy: — Ministry of Health and Welfare official, 2025 parliamentary audit
ministry.footnote: With separate legal mandates and data systems, even information sharing is impossible — and no integrated system exists to support a single adolescent continuously from initial counseling through treatment and aftercare.

homeV3.title: Where did addiction in Korea go in ten years?
homeV3.lead: Addiction is not an individual moral failure but a structural risk signal for society as a whole. Each type is drawn from one representative national indicator, exactly as published.
homeV3.heroRule: How the lead chart is picked: of the six representative indicators, the type whose value moved most relative to its first value (|last − first| ÷ first). Series with a survey design change are left out, because values on either side of a break are not compared.
homeV3.tileChangeBreak: {year} · survey design changed after {from} — not compared
homeV3.tileChangeNone: {year} · first survey — nothing earlier to compare
homeV3.stripNotAddiction: Game usage rate · not an addiction indicator
homeV3.scaleIndexNote: Index view: each value ÷ the series' first value × 100, so the lead chart and the five strips share one scale. Display only — stored values stay exactly as published.

policyMap.noPublicDataNote: "No public data" means this page could not confirm a value in the public government or agency documents it checked.

research.themeRule: Chosen by keyword rules: case management — "case management"; prevention programmes — "prevention program/intervention/curriculum", "school/family/community-based prevention" and their Korean forms, excluding relapse, suicide, infection and transmission prevention. No model judgement.
